subject.title: WhatsApp channel: expose ctwa_clid from Click-to-WhatsApp ads in session metadata

question: Should WhatsApp CTWA attribution data be exposed only as per-turn untrusted structured context, also included in plugin hook metadata, or persisted as session metadata for later Conversions API use?
rationale: The extraction is bounded, but the requested field is an ad click identifier and the issue explicitly asks for prompt/session exposure, so automation should not choose the visibility and retention boundary.

options.title: Per-turn untrusted context only
options.body: Extract `ctwaClid` and related ad fields in the WhatsApp plugin and expose them only through the existing fenced untrusted structured-context prompt path without durable persistence.

options.title: Plugin-hook attribution payload
options.body: Define a typed WhatsApp attribution payload for opted-in plugin hooks so a Conversions API plugin can consume it without putting the identifier into every agent prompt.

options.title: Persist session attribution
options.body: Store the first CTWA payload on session state with an explicit retention and redaction policy before implementation.

recommendation.title: Per-turn untrusted context only
recommendation.body: Extract `ctwaClid` and related ad fields in the WhatsApp plugin and expose them only through the existing fenced untrusted structured-context prompt path without durable persistence.

likelyOwner.reason: He owns the newest current-main code in the exact WhatsApp extraction, prompt metadata, and session metadata paths that would need the product/security boundary decision.
